text_block_list.text:
I visit the cafeteria and overhear two
familiar
voices talking...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Taishin! TAISHIN! You're always playing
that
game!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Is it really that fun?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Nope. It's just a bunch of dumb puzzles.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Then why do you play it?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Even if it's boring, I have to beat it. I feel
like the
creator is mocking me if I don't.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Let's do it together, then! Two heads are
better
than one, after all!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Huh? No thank y—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'm all ready to game! What do I
do first?
Show me!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Sigh... You never let up, do you?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: First, download the app on your phone...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: ...Okay, that's it. You got it?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Y-yep! Sounds super tough, though!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: But I'm gonna beat it! Like this!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
What?! I got a game over already?!
Hooow?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
That stage is Extreme Hell difficulty.
Even I
haven't beaten it yet.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Really? I bet I can! Hraaagh!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Hey, knock it off! There's no way you're
gonna be
able to just—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: ...Aaaaah! I did iiit!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: What?! How?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hmm? I dunno! I guess the secret is just
never
giving up?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
...Hold on. My turn now. If I just do this,
and then
this... Aha!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: The pair continue to game ferociously...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Done... All stages cleared...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Woohoooo! We did it, Taishin! We beat
the
game!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Will you be quiet for once?! And it's not
like we
did it together.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
But I'm so happy! I got to beat
something with
you, Taishin! Hehe!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
...You're really easy to please, aren't
you?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
